user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features; not shown in search answers if opted out.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads; not used to train models.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI's generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and GPT Actions; not used for automatic crawling or Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Web content gathered across public websites for AI model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to individual questions asked to Claude.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests retrieving content to answer user queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality and relevance.
user_agents.scope: Indexing web content for search optimization and user search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes and find information for Google Search and other products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google News, news.google.com, and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Shopping surfaces, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search Console testing tools with no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for product teams fetching public content or internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect specific products; used for generic public content fetching.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for various Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching public image URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for various Google product teams.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching public video URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl site owners' requests for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested for Vertex AI Agents, not affecting Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow rules targeting Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect and index data automatically from the internet for search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products including Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Apple foundation models powering generative AI features across Apple products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content associated with Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display summaries and previews.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta apps such as Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.scope: Web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawl web pages to provide accurate info and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawl web pages for Amazon search experiences; does not train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions such as fetching live web information for Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live fetching; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent CCBot or register for opt-out.
